title: Applied AI & Emerging Tech
businessQuestion: What practical workflows deliver measurable productivity before market saturation?
investorQuestion: Which domain-specific workflows erect sustainable data moats against generic frontier models?
overview: This is the broadest and least mature bucket on the site: hundreds of records, the large majority at proof of concept, spanning industrial, medical, agricultural and consumer applications. Read it as a map of where AI is being tried rather than a list of proven markets. The investment question is which narrow workflow accumulates proprietary data and switching costs before the generic model layer absorbs it.
